utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, by the way Sam, I heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks for the update Jules! Sunday works for me. Need me to bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Tool-wise, I think we're covered for the basics—maybe just bring whatever you're handy with!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Fliers? Oh right, the repair drive! I thought I had some somewhere, but I can't seem to find them. Maybe I forgot to print them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No worries, Oren — I can help print some if you want. Just send me the file and I'll run them off at the library.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That'd be great, Ira! But uh, I gotta be honest — I'm not sure if I even made a file yet. Let me check my email later and get back to you?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Faye, I've been hearing some buzz about a repair drive this Saturday, but the details are a bit jumbled. What have you heard?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: You know, I've been trying to get a straight answer about that too—Jules hasn't said a word about the start time, and with school drop-offs, I need to know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, it's hard to pin down the specifics. I heard from Quinn it's the garden shed, but Tess mentioned the community center—so I'm not sure which one's actually happening.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Actually, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center. I can use a hand with tool sorting.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sunday works for me. I'll be there to help sort tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, thanks Dane. I'll have the tools laid out by nine.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I think we should agree on a fixed morning time for our check-in. What works for you, Kira?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Eli — are we even sure the repair drive is definitely on for Saturday? I still haven't heard a straight answer about who's actually confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Kira, I've been planning on Saturday all along — I think we just need to pick a time and get on with it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, need any tools for the repair drive? I've got my kit all ready to lend out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, didn't you hear? It's been moved to Sunday at the community center. But no tools for me, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Wait, moved to Sunday? I'd better update my calendar — but I'll still have my tools ready if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, really? I thought it was Saturday! Sunday works too, I'll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, I'm glad it works for you. I'll see you there then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Heads up — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday. Tools are ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo. I had it down for Sunday at the community center anyway — glad that's confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, see you there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn. But I still need to know if there's a plan, or if we're all just showing up hoping for the best.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Pia, I've got you covered! The repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center — we're all set with a plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good to hear there's a plan, Rosa. Do we have a schedule or list of tasks, or is it just a general gathering?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey, I talked to Oren earlier and they're really excited about the repair drive. I should check with Noah to see if they're free this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I remember you mentioning it... but I'm not sure if I have it on my calendar. Did you say you're bringing the welding gear?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I've got the welder ready! So are you free this weekend to help out?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Cleo, did you say M6 and M8 bolts? I'll check my stash, but does anyone else have fasteners we can count on?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, M6 and M8. I'll ask around the neighborhood to see if anyone else has some.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, let me know what you find. Gus said he had tools to lend, so he might have some fasteners too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'll head over to the chalkboard and check those times and tasks—thanks for the tip, Tess!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You're welcome, Hana! I think there's even a sign-up for a bake sale too—I heard someone mention it while I was at the grocer's.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, a bake sale sign-up too? I'll make sure to look for that on the chalkboard. Thanks again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, I'm planning a repair drive this weekend—got a good feeling about it!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a heads up, the repair drive's moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's moved to Sunday? Good thing you told me—I was about to tell everyone Saturday! I'll spread the word about the new time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I keep meaning to get organized for it. Do you know what time we're starting on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? I thought it was Sunday... or maybe that's the block party. I'm all mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, you're right, I'm all turned around too. Maybe we should check with Quinn again?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Morning! Heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, good to know it's set for Sunday. I'll be there to lend a hand with whatever's needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Cool, see you there maybe. I'll try to make it if I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good morning! Have you heard about the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good morning! Yes, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center. I can check the exact start time for you if you'd like.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would be great, Jules. I'd appreciate a firm time before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds like a big project! Are you headed over to help out too?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure yet. They moved it to Sunday at the community center, so I might swing by and see what it's all about.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Sunday? That's good to know—I was worried I'd miss it. Maybe I'll see you there!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Opal. Can you catch me up on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh sure, I just heard the repair drive's been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks Opal, glad I caught that change. I'll be there on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Eli, have you seen any of the new welding gear from the repair drive? I'm hoping we can finally fix that playground fence.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven't seen the gear yet, but let's set a regular morning check-in time so we can coordinate better.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, a morning check-in sounds good. I'll bring my inventory list so we can track what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, need any tools for the repair drive? I've got plenty to lend.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Gus, don't forget about helping Jules coordinate too — we could really use your skills there!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Right, Mara! I can lend tools and help Jules coordinate. Count me in for both.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, Sunday at the community center. I'll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Take your time, Uli. We'll be there Sunday no matter what, but it'd be lovely to have you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll try to come by for a bit, but I might not stay long.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, are you coming to the repair drive? I could use a hand with some of the heavier stuff.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I do want to help, Mina, but I'm a bit worried—is this thing actually organized, or are we all just showing up and hoping for the best?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's organized, don't worry. There's a sign-up sheet and we've got tool lists. Are you in or not?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, I heard it's the community council organizing it, and yeah, it's definitely this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The community council? Last I heard, you weren't even sure who started it. Are you certain about this?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you know how it is—news travels fast around here! I heard it from Mrs. Delgado, and she's usually spot-on about these things.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I've been hearing a lot about that repair drive from everyone — sounds like the whole neighborhood's pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's great that everyone's getting involved, but I'm still trying to pin down the exact start time so I can juggle the school runs around it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I overheard Quinn saying it starts at 9 AM sharp, but you might want to double-check with them—I'm not 100% sure.
